title: Local cone structure of a radially invariant C¹ surface near p = r₀u
statement: For every P ∈ ℕ, every embedded C¹ 2-dimensional submanifold M ⊆ ℝ^P, every unit vector u ∈ ℝ^P, every r₀ > 0 with r₀u ∈ M and every ρ > 0 such that t·x ∈ M whenever x ∈ M ∩ B_ρ(r₀u), t > 0 and t·x ∈ B_ρ(r₀u): there exist a unit vector e with ⟨u, e⟩ = 0, a real s with 0 < s < r₀, an open N ⊆ ℝ^P with r₀u ∈ N ⊆ B_ρ(r₀u) and ⟨x, u⟩ > 0 for all x ∈ N, and γ : ℝ → ℝ^P that is C¹ on (−s, s) with γ(0) = u and γ′(0) = e, such that ‖γ(α)‖ = 1, ⟨γ(α), u⟩ > 0 and arctan(⟨γ(α),e⟩/⟨γ(α),u⟩) = α for every α ∈ (−s, s); M ∩ N = {tγ(α) : t ∈ (r₀ − s, r₀ + s), α ∈ (−s, s)}; and span(tangentSpace M (tγ(α))) = span{γ(α), γ′(α)} for all t ∈ (r₀ − s, r₀ + s) and α ∈ (−s, s).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (u : Euclid P) (r₀ ρ : ℝ), IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 2 M → ‖u‖ = 1 → 0 < r₀ → r₀ • u ∈ M → 0 < ρ → (∀ x ∈ M ∩ ball (r₀ • u) ρ, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t • x ∈ ball (r₀ • u) ρ → t • x ∈ M) → ∃ (e : Euclid P) (s : ℝ) (N : Set (Euclid P)) (γ : ℝ → Euclid P), ‖e‖ = 1 ∧ inner ℝ u e = 0 ∧ 0 < s ∧ s < r₀ ∧ IsOpen N ∧ r₀ • u ∈ N ∧ N ⊆ ball (r₀ • u) ρ ∧ (∀ x ∈ N, 0 < inner ℝ x u) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 γ (Ioo (-s) s) ∧ γ 0 = u ∧ deriv γ 0 = e ∧ (∀ α ∈ Ioo (-s) s, ‖γ α‖ = 1 ∧ 0 < inner ℝ (γ α) u ∧ Real.arctan (inner ℝ (γ α) e / inner ℝ (γ α) u) = α) ∧ M ∩ N = (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => q.1 • γ q.2) '' (Ioo (r₀ - s) (r₀ + s) ×ˢ Ioo (-s) s) ∧ ∀ t ∈ Ioo (r₀ - s) (r₀ + s), ∀ α ∈ Ioo (-s) s, Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M (t • γ α)) = Submodule.span ℝ {γ α, deriv γ α}
